title: What is the International Organisation of la Francophonie?
summary: With the 20th Francophonie Summit underway in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, all eyes are on the International Organisation of la Francophonie (OIF). But what is the OIF? Resembling the Commonwealth, this post-colonial bloc unites around 90 nations, from 53 full members to friendly states drawn by political and economic ties. Liza Kaminov breaks down what the organi…
